subject: planner: handle double NOT in outer join (#65942)
summary: For Left/Right Outer Join predicate pushdown, normalizes `OtherConditions` that contain an outer `NOT` by running `expression.PushDownNot` before `updateEQCond()`, so `NOT NOT (col = col)` becomes `col = col` and can be extracted as an equality join key; reviewed the rewrite path and its 3-valued-logic handling and found no Blocker/High correctness or compatibility issues.
